more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Sodium ferrocyanide is a sodium salt of the hexacyanoferrate(II) complex, specified in hydrated crystalline form. Its anti-caking role is to reduce the tendency of particles in a food powder to stick together. The specified material is supplied as yellow powder or crystalline material.
more_info.daily_intake: 0.03 mg ferrocyanide ion/kg body weight/day, combined ferrocyanides (EFSA, 2018).
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food uses raised no concern.
Higher-dose animal kidney effects supported the group limit.
